entity.summary: Open-source self-custody EVM wallet ecosystem distributed as a browser extension, mobile application, and desktop application.
entity.notes: Initial Rabby launch date is established by the reviewed July 26, 2021 first-party browser-extension release announcement; later Mobile and Desktop launch dates remain unset pending separate reviewed sources.

products.summary: Open-source Rabby browser extension for Ethereum and EVM chains.
products.notes: Initial browser-extension release date is established by the reviewed July 26, 2021 first-party Rabby release announcement.

products.summary: Rabby mobile wallet application for iOS and Android.
products.notes: Rabby's official mobile repository begins development in late 2023, then records version 0.1.0 being prepared for publishing on 2024-01-29 and an explicit publish of 0.1.1 on 2024-03-01. WLR records 2024 at year precision because the reviewed source history establishes the public release lineage during 2024 but does not establish one defensible exact first App Store or Play Store release day.

products.summary: Rabby desktop wallet application distributed for macOS and Windows.
products.notes: First-party Rabby Desktop source history establishes a 2022 release series, including desktop release packaging in September and Release v0.1.1 on 2022-09-30. WLR records year precision only because the reviewed history does not establish a defensible exact initial launch day or a surfaced v0.1.0 release commit.

events.title: Rabby browser-extension wallet introduced
events.description: The Rabby/DeBank team publicly introduced Rabby as a browser-extension wallet for DeFi users on July 26, 2021.

events.title: Rabby Swap smart contract exploited
events.description: Rabby reported that the Rabby Swap smart contract suffered a hack attack and that stolen funds were being tracked. Users who had used Swap were instructed to revoke existing approvals across chains, while Rabby stated that users who had not used Swap were unaffected.
events.affected_users_text: Users who had used Rabby Swap and retained approvals to the exploited contracts; Rabby stated that users who had not used Swap were unaffected.
events.notes: This is modeled as a feature-level smart-contract exploit affecting the then-current Rabby Browser Extension product, not as a browser key-storage compromise. WLR does not canonicalize an exact loss amount, affected-version range, or impact to later Mobile/Desktop products from these sources.

events.title: Rabby Desktop released in 2022
events.description: Rabby's official desktop source repository records desktop release packaging and a v0.1.1 release during 2022, establishing the desktop product as released by that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed repository does not surface a v0.1.0 release commit, so WLR does not infer an exact initial launch day from the 2022-09-30 v0.1.1 commit.

events.title: Rabby Mobile released in 2024
events.description: Rabby's official mobile repository establishes the transition from late-2023 development into a public mobile release lineage during 2024, including 0.1.0 publish preparation and an explicit 0.1.1 publish commit.
events.notes: Year precision only. The initial repository commit in 2023 is development evidence, not launch evidence; the 2024 publish-history does not establish one exact first public store-release day.

evidence.title: Privacy Policy | Debank & Rabby
evidence.notes: Primary legal source identifying OPCODE LABS PTE. LTD. and its Singapore address.

evidence.title: Rabby Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page lists Extension, Mobile, and Desktop products.

evidence.title: RabbyHub official repositories
evidence.notes: Official organization listing identifies rabby-mobile and RabbyDesktop as separate applications.

evidence.title: Rabby Release Announcement
evidence.notes: First-party Rabby publication introducing the new browser-extension wallet on July 26, 2021.

evidence.title: Rabby Swap smart contract has suffered from a hack attack
evidence.notes: Primary Rabby incident statement reporting the Swap smart-contract hack, stolen-fund tracking, and the distinction between users who had and had not used Swap.

evidence.title: Rabby Swap exploited contract approval revocation notice
evidence.notes: Primary Rabby follow-up listing exploited contract addresses across chains and instructing users to revoke approvals.

evidence.title: Rabby Wallet exploit prompts users to revoke access
evidence.notes: Contemporary reporting corroborating the Rabby Swap contract exploit, user-fund draining reports, and Rabby approval-revocation guidance.

evidence.title: Rabby Desktop Release v0.1.1
evidence.notes: Official Rabby Desktop source-repository release commit establishing that the desktop product was in release during 2022. WLR uses it to support year-level launch chronology, not as proof of the exact initial launch day.

evidence.title: Rabby Mobile 0.1.0 publish preparation
evidence.notes: Official Rabby Mobile repository commit that sets version 0.1.0 for publish and includes iOS App Store publishing configuration and Android build/deploy work. Used to establish the 2024 release lineage, not as an exact public launch-day assertion.

evidence.title: Rabby Mobile publish 0.1.1
evidence.notes: Official Rabby Mobile repository commit explicitly publishing version 0.1.1. Used as first-party corroboration that the public release lineage was active during 2024, not as proof that 2024-03-01 was the first launch day.
